tagline: The bench press with a dead stop on the chest.

videos.title: Paused Bench Press: Gym Shorts (How To)

coaching.summary: Lower the bar to your chest, hold it still for a moment while staying tight, then press it back up.
cues: Lower under control to the same touch point as your regular bench.
Let the bar settle motionless on the chest without sinking or bouncing.
Keep the shoulder blades pinned through the pause, then press hard.
